data_display.usage: Use for all numerical values, P&L, prices, and account balances.

cards.style: Flat, no shadow, sharp or minimal radius.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 shadow-sm transition-all active:scale-95

status_indicators.profit: text-green-500 bg-green-500/10 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-mono border border-green-500/20
status_indicators.loss: text-red-500 bg-red-500/10 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-mono border border-red-500/20
status_indicators.neutral: text-gray-400 bg-gray-500/10 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-mono border border-gray-500/20

visual_enhancers.grid_lines: Use subtle border-r and border-b on grid items to create a technical look.
visual_enhancers.risk_meter: Progress bars for FTMO limits must change color (Green -> Yellow -> Red) as limits approach.

animations.micro_interactions: Hover states on table rows (bg-accent/50), active states on tabs.
animations.data_updates: Flash background color green/red briefly on price updates (if possible).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text-gray-400 or lighter on dark backgrounds. Avoid dark gray on black.
accessibility.focus_states: Visible focus ring (ring-2 ring-primary) for keyboard navigation.

image_urls.logo_placeholder: Use a simple text logo 'FTMO DASH' with a monospace font if no SVG available.

assets.icons: Use Lucide React icons. Key icons: `TrendingUp`, `TrendingDown`, `ShieldAlert`, `Activity`, `Settings`, `LogOut`.

universal_guidelines: Do not use gradients for backgrounds. Stick to solid dark colors.
Use 'JetBrains Mono' for ALL financial data. It builds trust.
Risk Management Section must be the most visible element (Top Left or Top Center).
Always show 'Distance to Breach' for FTMO rules (e.g., '$450 left to daily loss limit').
Use 'sonner' for all trade notifications (Entry, Exit, Error).
instructions_to_main_agent: Focus on performance. The dashboard should feel 'instant'. Avoid heavy animations that delay data visibility. Prioritize the 'Risk Meter' widget—it's the core value proposition for FTMO traders.
